name: number-input
title: Number input
description: A number field with round − and + steppers that repeat while held. Type over it, use the arrow keys, or hold Shift for ten steps; it clamps to min and max with a small nudge, keeps the step's decimals, and reads 1,250 with a unit or a $ in front. The digits roll as they change.
author: UI Stacks <https://uistacks.dev>
